# Deep Work, notes

My own summary, not quotes.

## Main idea

Focused work without distraction is becoming rare and valuable at the same
time. Shallow work (email, meetings, quick replies) feels productive but rarely
moves anything important.

## Practices I want to keep

- Block two mornings a week for deep work, calendar and phone off.
- Batch email to twice a day.
- End the workday with a shutdown ritual: review tasks, plan tomorrow, stop.
- Embrace boredom: do not reach for the phone in every queue.

## Disagreements

The book underrates collaboration. Some of my best ideas came from interrupted
conversations.
